title: Parrot with sparkly eyes

  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d='M30 78 Q18 90 10 96 Q22 92 34 84 Z' fill='#2f7fd0'/>

  <path d='M38 52 Q30 66 36 82 Q48 78 52 62 Q50 54 46 50 Z' fill='#1f8a3c'/>

  <path d='M66 26 l0.9 2.2 l2.2 0.9 l-2.2 0.9 l-0.9 2.2 l-0.9 -2.2 l-2.2 -0.9 l2.2 -0.9 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
